title: Code Reviewer operator API, version 1
description: The wire format of the operator API (#275): a machine interface for an operator who sets the entitlements of workspaces from outside the app. Every request carries 'Authorization: Bearer <OPERATOR_API_TOKEN>'; a request body is application/json up to 16384 bytes, and GET and DELETE carry none. Every answer is JSON with 'Cache-Control: no-store' and the version in its body; an error is {version, error, field?} with a stable code, never a message. Until OPERATOR_API_TOKEN is set the paths do not exist (the 404 of a missing path, not this format). The API identifies workspaces by id and slug only: no names of people, no emails, no repositories, no pull requests. A reader ignores fields it does not know. This file is the only source of the format; the app tests validate real answers and contracts/examples/operator-api holds one valid example per definition.

Version.description: The version of the format; also in the path (/api/operator/v1).

WorkspaceId.description: The id of a workspace, as listed by GET /workspaces.

ApiErrorCode.description: Callers branch on the code. 401 unauthorized; 404 not_found (unknown path) or workspace_not_found; 405 method_not_allowed (with an Allow header); 400 body_not_allowed (a GET or DELETE with a body) or request_invalid (not JSON, or a bad query); 413 body_too_large; 415 unsupported_media_type; 409 period_start_backwards; 422 the other codes of a refused entitlement (the codes of the workspace entitlements validation, with 'field' naming the limit or key concerned); 500 internal_error.

field.description: For a refused entitlement: the limit or the unknown key concerned (never its value).

EntitlementLimits.description: Every limit is required on a write; null is unlimited.

diffRunsPerPeriod.description: A count (or micro-USD of measured model cost) per period, or null for unlimited.

dynamicRunsPerPeriod.description: A count (or micro-USD of measured model cost) per period, or null for unlimited.

managedCostLimitMicroUsd.description: A count (or micro-USD of measured model cost) per period, or null for unlimited.

EntitlementLimitsWrite.description: The limits of a write: every limit, and no other key (a typo is refused with limits_invalid).

diffRunsPerPeriod.description: A count (or micro-USD of measured model cost) per period, or null for unlimited.

dynamicRunsPerPeriod.description: A count (or micro-USD of measured model cost) per period, or null for unlimited.

managedCostLimitMicroUsd.description: A count (or micro-USD of measured model cost) per period, or null for unlimited.

EntitlementsFields.description: What an operator allows a workspace, as read back.

planLabel.description: A label for display and audit, 1 to 64 printable characters. The app never branches on it.

keyMode.description: Whose LLM key the workspace's reviews use. 'managed' is the operator's key.

suspensionCode.description: Why the workspace is suspended: lowercase letters, digits, '_' and '-', starting with a letter, at most 64 characters. null unless suspended.

EntitlementsWrite.description: The body of PUT /workspaces/{id}/entitlements and PUT /entitlements/default: the whole entitlements, replacing what was stored. Unknown keys are refused (a typo must not pass). 'periodStart' may be left out: the stored start is kept, or the period starts now when nothing is stored. A start earlier than the stored one is refused (period_start_backwards, 409) and one more than five minutes ahead as period_start_in_future. A write is idempotent. A numeric limit above 2^53-1 is refused (limit_invalid) instead of being rounded. Removing a workspace's row (DELETE) ends the 'never backwards' guard for that workspace: a later PUT without periodStart begins now.

planLabel.description: A label for display and audit, 1 to 64 printable characters. The app never branches on it.

keyMode.description: Whose LLM key the workspace's reviews use. 'managed' is the operator's key.

suspensionCode.description: Why the workspace is suspended: lowercase letters, digits, '_' and '-', starting with a letter, at most 64 characters. null unless suspended.

InvalidEntitlements.description: A stored entry that cannot be read. It counts as 'invalid' for enforcement (fail closed); a valid PUT repairs it.

StoredEntitlements.description: The row of a workspace, with the time of its last write. Who wrote it is not part of the format.

EffectiveEntitlements.description: What applies to the workspace on its next claim: its own row, else the default, else nothing (unlimited: own key, no limits, not suspended). A running job is not touched.

EntitlementsSource.description: 'workspace': the workspace's own row. 'default': the instance default.

WorkspaceList.description: GET /workspaces?after=<id>&limit=<1..200, default 50>: workspaces ordered by id after the cursor. 'nextAfter' is the id to pass as 'after' for the next page, null on the last page.

WorkspaceEntitlementsResponse.description: The answer of GET, PUT and DELETE /workspaces/{id}/entitlements: the stored row (null when none, e.g. after DELETE) and the effective entitlements.

DefaultEntitlementsResponse.description: The answer of GET and PUT /entitlements/default: the default for workspaces without a row, an invalid marker for damaged data, or null when none was set. The default cannot be removed through the API.
